risk_note: F1-01qa (FU-H5-OPTIONAL-AUTH from the CT-13d review S2; orchestrator D10-1744 / D10-1745; landed per D10-1772). The H5 app API now separates x-auth none (security []) from optional ({}): optional requests go through the current session and carry the H5 token when native hands one out (read_only included); when getting a token fails (90401, timeout, malformed, 90001 or no such method) and nothing was sent yet, the request goes out once without a token, no local refusal and no prompt; a failure after the token was sent (10002 not renewable, replay still 10002) is returned as is, never re-sent anonymously; after auth.changed every optional request of the old session is dropped with AccountChangedError. none operations never ask for a token; signed operations are still refused locally. No bridge contract change; the guest meaning of 90401 is parked as FU-BRIDGE-H5TOKEN-GUEST-CODE. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context): 15 tests; another independent Claude spec-test r1 fail (S1: concurrent requests not pinned to one token acquisition) and r2 pass after a second test round. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); couli-ci verify:fast run 1 and --browser run 1 green. Written by hand.
